name: corvo-mail
description: Corvo — Cliente de e-mail desktop calmo com Gmail real, Keychain e IA local llama.cpp

scripts.tauri:dev: cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --bin corvo-llm-worker && tauri dev
scripts.tauri:build: cargo build --release --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --bin corvo-llm-worker && tauri build --bundles app && cp src-tauri/target/release/corvo-llm-worker src-tauri/target/release/bundle/macos/Corvo.app/Contents/MacOS/corvo-llm-worker
